headline: I earn it and it's gone. What's blocking my money?
note: Wired 2026-08-25 from fb-tarot/docs/writeups/shadow/REVIEW-money-alone-commit-2026-08-25.md — approved copy, transferred verbatim. Reuses the existing MONEY_TAROT_HOOKS frame; no new guard.

a: You turned the Magician. You reached without seeing the card and found the worker of the three.
Both hands are busy above a table where all four tools are ready.
You said you earn the money and then it is gone. The working hands are where this card makes me stop.
You do earn it, and the money still does not stay.
Something stands between earning the money and keeping it. I don't think it began with you.
Let me look closer at what's holding the money…
b: You turned the Hanged Man. The pictures were hidden, but your hand went to the one caught at one point.
One rope catches one ankle. Everything else hangs free.
You asked what blocks money that will not stay. This card brings me to the single place where movement is caught.
Still, the money meets a hold after the earning you described.
Something appears after the earning, just as the money should stay. I don't think it started with you.
Let me see what that obstruction is…
c: You turned the Fool. Nothing set the backs apart, yet you chose the one travelling with very little.
Look at the bundle on his stick. It is the only thing he carries.
You said you earn it and it goes. What catches me is the one small bundle that travels with him.
But what you earn is gone, while the card keeps carrying its bundle forward.
The thing that has hold of what you earn keeps it from travelling with you. I don't think this began with you.
Now let's look at what's behind this…
